description: Full metadata for one HealthData.gov dataset by its Socrata id (a 4x4 like "g62h-syeh", returned by search_datasets). Returns title, description, owning agency, licence, every column with its type, row count and the last data update. NOTE: HealthData.gov migrated off CKAN, so an old CKAN package id or slug will NOT resolve — search for the dataset again to get its 4x4.
name: get_dataset
